arcs.title: The New Registry
arcs.summary: Day 1: The 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry has been opened at the Ministry with one file. Quoyne has shelved it personally and confirmed it is plumb. The question now circulating quietly: is there a second entry coming? Several Ministry departments have apparently reviewed their own recent unusual files with new interest. Day 2 should develop a candidate — a second case being considered for the category, perhaps something connected to Christine, Steve, or the household that a Ministry desk is quietly reviewing for possible reclassification.
